text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
-- Proposed revision to property tax could triple government revenues. Law already before parliament.
-- Right-wing Popular Party leader Manual Monteiro launches campaign for signatures in favour of a referendum on monetary union.

-- Sonae chief Belmiro de Azevedo underwrites nearly half of the 49 percent of Sonae Imobiliaria to be sold as only the sale of 25 percent to a strategic partner effectively guaranteed, newspaper quotes source close to the transaction as saying.
